scope: Four development follow-up projects after observing the original twelve-project cohort: two exact original counterexamples and two newly authored runtime boundary controls. This is repair validation, not new unseen evaluation. The original cohort and original implementation snapshot remain unchanged.
referenceMethod: Source-derived reference labels reviewed before follow-up model execution; labels and rationales are not provider inputs. AI independent adjudication is not a human study.

projects.title: Fictional Lantern Museum
projects.summary: Lantern Museum needs a website describing its admission price and Saturday opening time.

files.index.html:
Home

Lantern Museum

Admission: AUD 12.

Saturday opens at 10:00.

FAQ
files.faq.html:
Home

Visitor FAQ

Admission costs AUD 9.

On Saturday we open at 11:00.

criteria.title: Consistent admission price
criteria.source: Every page must consistently state an admission price of AUD 12.

reference.rationale: Home is correct but FAQ givesAUD9, so the all-pages condition fails.

criteria.title: Consistent Saturday hours
criteria.source: Every page must consistently state that Saturday opening time is 10:00.

reference.rationale: FAQ says11:00 while the home page says10:00.

projects.title: Fictional Fern Walks
projects.summary: Fern Walks needs a website describing its cancellation policy and meeting point.

files.index.html:
Home

Fern Walks

Meet at the north gate of Fern Reserve.

Policy
files.policy.html:
Home

Cancellation notice

Cancel forty-eight hours or more before departure and your whole fee is returned.

criteria.title: Cancellation policy copy
criteria.source: The page copy must say cancellations made at least 48 hours before departure receive a full refund.

reference.rationale: Forty-eight hours or more means at least 48 hours; whole fee returned means a full refund. No exact phrase was required.

criteria.title: Meeting point copy
criteria.source: The page copy must name the north gate of Fern Reserve as the meeting point.

reference.rationale: Home copy gives that meeting point exactly.

projects.title: Fictional Acacia Walks
projects.summary: Acacia Walks needs a website for cancellation requests and refunds to the original payment method.

files.index.html:
Acacia Walks

Cancel at least 48 hours before departure for a full refund.

Cancellation request
files.refund.html:
Cancellation request

Your refund will be sent to your original payment method.

criteria.title: Actual refund receipt
criteria.source: After a cancellation request is submitted, the payment service must actually refund the full payment to the original card and the customer must receive the money.

reference.rationale: A form and promised outcome do not establish execution of the payment API, refund settlement or receipt.

criteria.title: Failed refund state preservation
criteria.source: If the payment provider declines the refund, the database must preserve the original reservation and record the refund failure.

reference.rationale: No backend, database or failed-provider interaction was executed; source copy does not prove conditional state preservation.

projects.title: Fictional Birch Walks
projects.summary: Birch Walks needs cancellation information, Saturday hours and an online reservation service.

files.index.html:

files.reserve.html:
Reservation request

Saturday opening time is 10:00.

criteria.title: Cancellation copy and actual payment
criteria.source: The page copy must say cancellations made at least 48 hours before departure receive a full refund, and the payment service must complete that refund to the original card.

reference.rationale: The first clause is policy copy but the entire requirement also requires an actual financial operation; matching text does not establish its execution.

criteria.title: Saturday copy and concurrent reservations
criteria.source: Every page must consistently state that Saturday opening time is 10:00, and concurrent reservations must never overbook the departure.

reference.rationale: The Saturday text is consistent, but no concurrent request or backend transaction ran; mixed runtime requirements stay unverified.
